advisories.title: Extract the secretariat donor fixture.
advisories.body: The complete donor projection is embedded inline in the render call. A named fixture keeps the test assertion focused on filter behavior and makes later projection-field changes easier to review.
evidence: Premise: __tests__/secretariat-donors-client.test.tsx:11 embeds all donor fields inside render → Improvement: fixture changes and interaction assertions become visually separate → Fix: declare a `const donor` fixture above the test and pass `[donor]` to the component.
__tests__/secretariat-donors-client.test.tsx:10-15 → one-line setup contains both projection data and test behavior.
